verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm a free developer account that works with the same Box API and developer tokens (box-docs-31, box-docs-17). Community posts confirm a consumer free tier with published limits, a 250 MB max file size and 10 GB monthly bandwidth, and one user signed up and used the desktop client (box-comm-2, box-comm-5, box-comm-6). Missing for 10: a first-party published free-tier storage quota, official pricing/tier docs, and current (non-dated) evidence that the free tier uses the same clients.
